title: Permissions-Policy allow-list is not closed
description: The Permissions-Policy value opens a feature allow-list with `(` and never closes it. The parser cannot attribute the remaining text to a feature, so the declared restrictions after the opening parenthesis are dropped and the policy is not the one the deployment wrote.
remediation: Close every allow-list and separate features with commas, for example `camera=(self), microphone=()`. Validate the header with a parser before shipping a policy change.
limitation: One header value. The rule detects the unclosed parenthesis only; it does not evaluate which feature ends up enabled by the browser default.
